title: The image of Our Lady of Guadalupe appears to Juan Diego
summary: According to tradition, the Virgin Mary appeared to the indigenous convert Juan Diego on the hill of Tepeyac, and her image was found imprinted on his cloak.
reason: The account arose in the decade after the Spanish conquest, when friars were seeking to convert the indigenous people of Mexico.
significance: Guadalupe became the most important religious and national symbol of Mexico and a major Catholic pilgrimage site.
place: Hill of Tepeyac, Mexico City, Mexico
